response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile and accomplished full-stack/systems engineer with strong low-latency and infrastructure experience, but his career has been overwhelmingly focused on web technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) with only brief, dated C/C++ exposure (2014-2015) and no evidence of Rust, geospatial routing pipelines, or navigation systems despite a tangential GIS hobby project. The core requirement of modern C++/Rust production experience plus routing/navigation domain knowledge is not demonstrated.
strengths: Broad, adaptable engineering background across many stacks and paradigms
Genuine GIS/mapping side project (GISCollective) showing geospatial interest
Strong distributed systems and high-throughput/low-latency experience (Dunnhumby, DLang fibers, async I/O)
concerns: No recent or substantial C++ experience (last significant use was 2014-2015) and no Rust experience at all
No professional experience with routing/navigation guidance systems or tiling pipelines
Career trajectory has moved further away from systems/C++ work toward TypeScript/web/AI tooling in recent roles

key_factors.factor: Lack of modern C++/Rust production experience
Strong distributed systems and adaptability track record
